mapper.sql: notice_id, title, content, pinned, hidden, publish_date, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM notice ORDER BY pinned DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT FROM notice WHERE hidden = FALSE AND publish_date <= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY pinned DESC, publish_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (title, content, pinned, publish_date) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{pinned}, #{publishDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, pinned = #{pinned}, publish_date = #{publishDate}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
